title: Listening Drill — Volunteer pace walk — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Volunteer pace walk — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on volunteer pace walk last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with uneven pace. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: fallen branch.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of route length so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow walking shoes instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the group leader before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Thursday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
